observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang apat na pangkat ng BHWE conditions, naihihiwalay ang kabuuang serbisyo sa qualifying accredited service, at nakabubuo ng tiyak na CSC verification question tungkol sa ebidensiya/uncertainty nang walang pangako ng eligibility o appointment.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Explains the four BHWE condition groups, distinguishes total service from qualifying accredited service, and forms a specific CSC question about evidence/uncertainty without promising eligibility or appointment.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Itinuturing pa rin na sapat ang accreditation, total years o JO/COS label, o nangangako ng BHWE/trabaho nang walang kondisyon at verification.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Still treats accreditation, total years or a JO/COS label as sufficient, or promises BHWE/a job without conditions and verification.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang kondisyon, accredited-service count at uncertainty, at tiyak na CSC verification nang walang untag o pangako.
levels.kaya_na_en: Accurate conditions, accredited-service count and uncertainty, and specific CSC verification without prompts or promises.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng untag sa edukasyon, service period, arrangement o ebidensiya/contact.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs prompts for education, service period, arrangement or evidence/contact.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa naihihiwalay ang kondisyon at serbisyo, nagpapasya mula sa label, o nagpapatuloy ang pangako ng approval/appointment.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot yet distinguish conditions and service, decides from a label, or persists with promises of approval/appointment.
